explication: This repository is a Claude Code skill: developers or agents invoke focused Python commands to build/test Xcode projects or control and inspect iOS simulators. The main interaction path is semantic UI navigation and device/app control, with accessibility, visual, log, and app-state analysis as diagnostic branches. Build results are summarized for on-demand detail; HangBuster is a separate hang-monitoring workflow. Shared simulator utilities support the scripts. Relationships among unsampled features are included only where the README documents them; source excerpts are partial.
